decisions.text: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
zero included (a narrow range far from zero wants an inset)
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, none moved
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
dotted only where the values are of lower certainty: Budget throughout
a projection continues its line dotted, in its colour, from the last actual value; the label at its end
reference series in the reserved dark grey, labelled in bold: Budget
the unit phrase on the top label: “$120K (expenses per month)”; the top gridline starts after it
digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$120K (expenses per month)”
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)

source.shows: the book's “only lines” version for the pattern of change: the expenses a line, the budget a target, dotted in the reserved grey (D-21 (c))
